I read all three documents: the CV, the profile export and the reference letter. Before I write anything, I have five questions. Answer in any order, and skip any you would rather not answer.

1. Your CV says "Senior Designer" at Alder Works from 2019, and the profile export says "Design Lead" for the same years. Which title do you want on applications?
2. The reference letter mentions a team of 12. Was that your team, or the whole studio?
3. Which cities would you work from, and is remote work a requirement or a preference?
4. What salary range would make you say yes without negotiating? (optional)
5. Is there anything in your history you would rather not bring up in a cover letter?
